title: Expected Cost Under an Additive Shift
statement: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on pairs $(b,m)$, with $m$ a natural number, and let $n$ be a natural number. If the distribution is changed by replacing each pair $(b,m)$ with $(b,m+n)$, its expected second coordinate is the expected second coordinate under $p$ plus $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\beta \times \mathbb{N}$
